title: Pathetic Money Waste
body: I downloaded this because I was too lazy to open my computer to view a model a friend sent me. Fortunately I am not lazy enough to spend money to view more than a single file a day when I have the option of nearly a dozen completely free apps on my PC to look at more than a single model.

title: Too many adds
body: I’m deleting cause you can’t even look at anything anymore

title: Unusable and shameless
body: Completely riddled with ads. Can’t look at a file for more than 15 seconds without getting an ad

title: Ad scam
body: Loads ads every time you look at a file. Junk App!

title: The most ads I’ve ever seen and it’s not even close.
body: Pop-up Ads every 30 seconds. Completely unusable.
